chain.description: The blockchain network to use. Allowed values: main, test, signet, regtest.

datadir.description: Directory to hold blocks and wallet data.

server.description: Enable server mode to accept JSON-RPC commands.

rpcport.description: Port to listen for JSON-RPC connections.

rpcbind.description: Bind to given address to listen for JSON-RPC connections.

rpcallowip.description: List of IP addresses allowed to connect via JSON-RPC.

port.description: Listen for connections on this port.

bind.description: Bind to given address for peer connections.

connect.description: List of nodes to connect to exclusively. If empty, automatic discovery is used.

addnode.description: List of nodes to add to the connection list.

dnsseed.description: Query for peer addresses via DNS lookup.

wallets.description: Paths to wallet files or directories to load at startup.

walletdir.description: Directory to hold wallet data files.

addresstype.description: Type of addresses to use. Options: legacy, p2sh-segwit, bech32.

changetype.description: Type of change to use. Options: legacy, p2sh-segwit, bech32.

debuglogfile.description: Location of debug log file relative to datadir.

prune.description: Reduce storage requirements by pruning old blocks (in MiB). 0 disables pruning.

par.description: Number of script verification threads. 0 = auto.

dbcache.description: Maximum database cache size in MiB.

maxmempool.description: Keep the transaction memory pool below this size in megabytes.

debug.description: Output debugging information. '1' for all, or specific categories like 'net,tor'.
